_: Raw public-rate observations. Each row is what Expedia rendered in a real browser for one property, one 7-night stay from `in`, two adults, on `at`. Rooms: n = room name as shown, p = nightly (USD, room only unless the property is all-inclusive), t = 7-night total, hb/ai = half-board / all-inclusive supplements per stay where the page showed them (unreliable, kept for context). Sold-out weeks are simply absent. Build with node tools/build-rates.js.

sampled.method: expedia.com property page in a real browser, chkin/chkout set, rm1=a2
